title: Hurricane Irma
description: Members from the 129th Rescue Wing, California Air National Guard, 125th Special Tactics Squadron, Oregon Air National Guard, and support Airmen from both ANG and active duty Air Force units prepare to board a C-130H Hercules at Hurlburt Field, Florida, to support the Hurricane Irma relief and personnel recovery mission in south Florida, September 11, 2017. Air National Guard and active duty Air Force units from across the U.S. are providing support to the Florida Air National Guard during and after Hurricane Irma.  (US Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Franklin Harris)
